title: Launch the omicsApp Shiny application — launch
text: port Integer port number. NULL (default), Shiny chooses free port. host Host address bind . Default "127.0.0.1" (local ). Use "0.0.0.0" running inside container behind proxy. project Optional path existing .omp project file open startup. launch.browser Logical. TRUE (default), open app user's default browser. Set FALSE headless server environments. workers Integer number background workers asynchronous analyses. 0 keeps current future plan untouched (useful tests, sequential want). max_upload_mb Maximum accepted upload size megabytes. Shiny's built-default 5 MB, size typical omics expression workbook. ... Additional arguments passed shiny::runApp().

text: Two settings matter omicsApp served rather run laptop, default laptop-friendly values: host = "0.0.0.0" binds interfaces reverse proxy (container port mapping) can reach app. Keep default "127.0.0.1" local use. workers controls many background R processes long analyses offloaded . Without , future::future() run_async() falls back sequential plan every computation blocks Shiny event loop — one user running DESeq2 freezes every session sharing process. Linux (including inside container) workers > 0 selects future::multicore, forks therefore shares parent's expression matrices copy--write. forking unavailable unsafe — Windows, RStudio — falls back future::multisession, serialises captured data worker instead.
